Players Committee card image of [[Chewbacca (V)]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots (3 if Falcon). May deploy -1 as a 'react' (-2 to same location as Han). If you have completed a Kessel Run, opponent's Force retrieval is canceled. During battle here (or at a holosite), your dejariks are destiny +2.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1fa635b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/Large/Chewbacca.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/Large/Chewbacca.gif] as of commit 1fa635b “virtual set 13 cards” (9 November 2020).
